Initial release of skill-publisher.

- Publish local Agent skills to multiple platforms: ClawHub, GitHub Releases, SkillHub CN.
- Supports validation, packaging, version management, and one-click multi-platform publishing.
- Plugin-based adapter architecture enables easy platform extension.
- Includes detailed interface specs and guides for adding new platforms.
- Enforces safety rules (validate before publish, sensitive file filtering, credential protection).
- Provides CLI commands for validation, packaging, publishing, version management, status, and platform info.
